introduction: This spec extends the `GitRunner` in `internal/gitcmd` with new git CLI convenience methods required by the carry-patch workflow, introduces typed conflict error types for cherry-pick and merge operations, and fixes a working-tree staleness bug in the upstream sync fast-forward path.

glossary.CherryPickConflictError: Typed error returned by CherryPick when git cherry-pick exits with conflicts; contains a ConflictingFiles []string field.
glossary.GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL: Environment variable set by GitRunner to restrict which git transport protocols are permitted.
glossary.GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: Environment variable set by GitRunner to ignore system-level git configuration.
glossary.GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: Environment variable set to 0 by GitRunner to prevent git from prompting for credentials interactively.
glossary.GitError: Typed error returned by GitRunner when a git command exits with a non-zero code and the exit code does not map to a more specific error type.
glossary.GitRunner: The Go struct in internal/gitcmd that wraps git CLI invocations with safety environment variables, allowlists, and typed error returns (spec 11).
glossary.HardReset: go-git ResetOptions mode that resets both the index and working tree to match the target commit.
glossary.MergeNoFFConflictError: Typed error returned by MergeNoFF when git merge --no-ff exits with conflicts; contains a ConflictingFiles []string field.
glossary.RebaseConflictError: Existing typed conflict error in internal/gitcmd returned by the Rebase method (spec 11).
glossary.carry-patch workflow: A multi-spec feature (carry_patch_workspace and carry_patch_operations specs) that applies patches across workspace branches using cherry-pick and rebase operations.
glossary.defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn: The function in internal/workspace responsible for advancing the local branch ref during a sync fast-forward (spec 13).
glossary.extraEnv: Additional environment variables injected into git subprocess invocations by GitRunner to enforce safety (e.g. GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0).
glossary.integration branch: The primary branch within a workspace repository into which agent work branches are merged.
glossary.parseRebaseConflictFiles: Existing internal function in internal/gitcmd that parses CONFLICT lines from git stdout/stderr to extract conflicting file paths.
glossary.rerere: Git's reuse-recorded-resolution mechanism that can automatically resolve previously seen conflicts during rebase --continue.
glossary.runWithExitCode: Internal GitRunner helper that runs a git command and returns both the output and the raw exit code for exit-code-discriminated logic.
glossary.startPoint: A commit SHA or ref name used as the starting point when creating a new branch.
glossary.sync fast-forward: The operation in the upstream sync path (spec 13) that advances the local integration branch ref to match the upstream HEAD without a merge commit.
glossary.workDir: The absolute filesystem path of the git repository that a GitRunner instance operates on.
glossary.worktree: The go-git Worktree object obtained from a Repository, used to perform working-tree operations such as Reset.

requirements.title: Safety environment variables on all new methods

user_story.goal: ensure all new GitRunner methods enforce the same safety environment as existing methods
user_story.benefit: so that new methods cannot hang on prompts, use system config, or use disallowed protocols

acceptance_criteria.action: injects GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, and GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL into every git subprocess spawned by the new methods, identical to the extraEnv set used by existing methods
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: all new methods inherit the same safety environment as Rebase and other existing GitRunner methods

edge_cases.action: GitRunner's extraEnv values take precedence over the inherited environment
edge_cases.return_contract: the subprocess runs with GitRunner's safety values regardless of the caller's environment
edge_cases.error_condition: the caller's environment contains conflicting values for GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT or GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM when a new method spawns a git subprocess

correctness_properties.title: CherryPick always aborts on conflict before returning
correctness_properties.for_any: commit SHA that causes a cherry-pick conflict
correctness_properties.invariant: CherryPick runs `git cherry-pick --abort` before returning a CherryPickConflictError, leaving the repository in a clean state

correctness_properties.title: MergeNoFF always aborts on conflict before returning
correctness_properties.for_any: branch that causes a merge conflict
correctness_properties.invariant: MergeNoFF runs `git merge --abort` before returning a MergeNoFFConflictError, leaving the repository in a clean state

correctness_properties.title: IsAncestor exit code discrimination is exhaustive
correctness_properties.for_any: pair of commit SHAs passed to IsAncestor
correctness_properties.invariant: exit code 0 maps to (true, nil), exit code 1 maps to (false, nil), and any other exit code maps to (false, *GitError) — no exit code is silently ignored

correctness_properties.title: Sync working tree reset is best-effort and never fails the sync
correctness_properties.for_any: sync fast-forward operation that advances the local branch ref
correctness_properties.invariant: a failure in worktree.Reset after a successful ref update does not cause defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn to return an error

correctness_properties.title: All new methods propagate context cancellation without hanging
correctness_properties.for_any: new GitRunner method called with a cancelled or deadline-exceeded context
correctness_properties.invariant: the method returns within a bounded time after context cancellation, killing the git subprocess if necessary

correctness_properties.title: ConflictingFiles fallback is always non-empty
correctness_properties.for_any: conflict error returned by CherryPick or MergeNoFF
correctness_properties.invariant: ConflictingFiles always contains at least one entry — either parsed file paths or the fallback "(unresolved conflict)" string

correctness_properties.title: New methods never terminate the process
correctness_properties.for_any: error condition encountered by any new GitRunner method
correctness_properties.invariant: errors are returned as Go error values; no new method calls os.Exit or panics on recoverable errors

execution_paths.title: CherryPick happy path: commit applied and new HEAD returned

steps.action: calls GitRunner.CherryPick(ctx, sha)
builds git cherry-pick command with extraEnv safety variables
spawns git cherry-pick subprocess in workDir
applies the commit cleanly and exits 0
reads the new HEAD SHA via git rev-parse HEAD
receives (newHeadSHA, nil)

execution_paths.title: CherryPick conflict path: auto-abort and typed error returned

steps.action: calls GitRunner.CherryPick(ctx, sha)
spawns git cherry-pick subprocess in workDir
exits non-zero with CONFLICT lines in output
calls parseRebaseConflictFiles on combined output to extract conflicting file paths
spawns git cherry-pick --abort subprocess to restore clean state
constructs CherryPickConflictError with ConflictingFiles
receives ("", *CherryPickConflictError) and inspects ConflictingFiles

execution_paths.title: MergeNoFF happy path: merge commit SHA returned

steps.action: calls GitRunner.MergeNoFF(ctx, branch)
builds git merge --no-ff command with extraEnv safety variables
spawns git merge --no-ff subprocess in workDir
creates a merge commit and exits 0
reads the new HEAD SHA via git rev-parse HEAD
receives (mergeCommitSHA, nil)
calls GitRunner.IsAncestor(ctx, commitA, commitB)
builds git merge-base --is-ancestor command
spawns subprocess via runWithExitCode to capture raw exit code
exits with 0 (ancestor), 1 (not ancestor), or other (error)
maps exit code 0 to (true, nil), exit code 1 to (false, nil), other to (false, *GitError)
receives a boolean result or a typed error

execution_paths.title: Sync fast-forward with working tree reset

steps.action: initiates a sync fast-forward for a workspace
advances the local branch ref to the new upstream HEAD SHA via Storer.SetReference
opens the workspace repository with go-git PlainOpen
obtains the worktree from the go-git repository
calls worktree.Reset with HardReset mode targeting the new HEAD SHA
on-disk files are updated to match the new HEAD commit
returns nil to the sync caller; working tree is now consistent with the ref

execution_paths.title: Sync fast-forward with best-effort working tree reset failure

steps.action: initiates a sync fast-forward for a workspace
advances the local branch ref to the new upstream HEAD SHA via Storer.SetReference
attempts to open the repository and call worktree.Reset
returns an error (e.g. filesystem lock or I/O failure)
logs the error at error level
returns nil to the sync caller; ref update is preserved, working tree will self-correct on next mutation

error_handling.behavior: GitRunner runs git cherry-pick --abort, parses CONFLICT lines via parseRebaseConflictFiles, and returns *CherryPickConflictError with ConflictingFiles populated
GitRunner runs git merge --abort, parses CONFLICT lines via parseRebaseConflictFiles, and returns *MergeNoFFConflictError with ConflictingFiles populated

error_handling.condition: context is cancelled during CherryPick or MergeNoFF
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner returns ctx.Err() without running the abort command; the caller is responsible for calling MergeAbort or equivalent cleanup

error_handling.condition: conflict output cannot be parsed by parseRebaseConflictFiles
error_handling.behavior: ConflictingFiles is set to ["(unresolved conflict)"] as a fallback; the abort still runs and the typed conflict error is returned

error_handling.condition: worktree.Reset fails after a successful sync fast-forward ref update
error_handling.behavior: defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn logs the error at error level and returns nil; the sync is not failed

error_handling.condition: git merge-base --is-ancestor exits with a code other than 0 or 1
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner returns (false, *GitError) wrapping the exit code and stderr

error_handling.condition: any new GitRunner method receives an empty required string argument
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner returns a *GitError immediately without spawning a git subprocess

error_handling.condition: git cherry-pick --abort fails after a conflict
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner logs the abort failure and returns the original *CherryPickConflictError

error_handling.condition: git merge --abort fails after a MergeNoFF conflict
error_handling.behavior: GitRunner logs the abort failure and returns the original *MergeNoFFConflictError
